run_clvp_encoder_tests: run the ClvpEncoderTest suite to verify encoder model config and output shapes
run_clvp_decoder_tests: run the ClvpDecoderTest suite to verify decoder causal LM generation and training
run_clvp_conditional_generation_tests: run the ClvpModelForConditionalGenerationTest suite to verify the full conditional generation model
